body:
## Owner request and scope

> We can do all of that cleanup. We also now have the RG SP online and the Nova online. If you want to commence those transfers, you have approval.

This is the RG SP (Tailnet100.75.221.73), not the separately updated RG35XX SP, and the Retroid Pocket Nova (Tailnet100.84.232.105). Transfer the already accepted #555 H70003/SM855005 engineering builds from bc9dfe8141. Their shared version is0.0.1-dev+20261011T222153Z.gbc9dfe8141d9. #556 remains closed and is not replayed. Host cleanup remains #493; preserve update inputs and immediate test/recovery dependencies until released.

Can this be done on the VM? No: these approved transfers and installed/read-only acceptance bind the actual handheld identities, card storage, board boot and Tailnet. Shared software is already VM20-qualified; no game, screenshot, input or deliberate personal-cloud operation is included.

Current authorization: transfer both builds. A separate concise reboot question is pending under docs/device-testing-policy.md; do not reboot without the named answer. Preserve all current credentials, selected paths, saves and settings. Any enabled automatic sync or unexpected state is resolved before applying an update.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Per-device current identity/boot/power/storage/idle state, update queue and automation are read; private preservation inventories and exact artifact/source hashes bind the proposed action.
- [ ] Each approved transfer uses tools/device-act, a temporary download outside the update queue, full device-side checksum and repeated state guard before queueing; original watcher/result channels and actual owner exits are recorded.
- [ ] If separately authorized, one reboot per device returns on the expected build with installed system/kernel/bootloader/device-tree/native hashes, mounts/empty update queue and frontend state verified. Otherwise record transfer-only status explicitly without claiming installed acceptance.
- [ ] Post-update protected payload/settings/credential/path preservation and bounded startup findings are verified; compact sanitized evidence, device facts, M7 and checkpoint are reconciled. No public RC claim.

## Current execution status

#557 fresh RG SP/Nova transfers are authorized and both Tailnet identities read correctly on older8b5113fa16. Both idle, empty update queue, auto cloud sync off. RG SP charging94%; Nova64% without external power, connection requested. Transfers have not started: named preservation-hash approval is pending after automatic approval review rejected raw configuration capture and then credential-derived hashes; no raw configuration copy occurred. Reboot approval is separately pending. Host #493 fresh inventory is actively watched at /workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-retention-20261012-inventory01, launcher1858669; no deletion yet. Current update bundles/required sources/evidence stay protected.
title: M7.P5: Update RG SP and Retroid Pocket Nova with accepted firmware
